description: This file defines the RooIgnoreController class which manages file access control based on ignore patterns specified in a .kilocodeignore file. It uses the 'ignore' library and integrates with VSCode APIs to watch for changes and validate file access for LLM operations.

classes.name: RooIgnoreController
classes.description: A class that manages ignore patterns for file access, sets up file watchers, and provides methods to validate access and commands based on ignore rules.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with the current working directory and sets up file watching.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads ignore patterns from the .kilocodeignore file.

methods.name: setupFileWatcher
methods.description: Sets up VSCode file system watchers for changes to the .kilocodeignore file.

methods.name: loadRooIgnore
methods.description: Reads and loads ignore patterns from the .kilocodeignore file if it exists.

methods.name: validateAccess
methods.description: Checks if a given file path should be accessible based on ignore patterns, resolving symlinks.

methods.name: validateCommand
methods.description: Determines if a terminal command that reads files is allowed based on ignore rules.

methods.name: filterPaths
methods.description: Filters a list of paths, removing those that are ignored.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disposables when the controller is no longer needed.

methods.name: getInstructions
methods.description: Provides formatted instructions about the ignore patterns for the LLM.
